headline: Vaca Muerta Oil Sur Completes $300 Million Debt Program with Bond Placement
summary: Vaca Muerta Oil Sur (VMOS) placed $66 million in debt, completing its $300 million debt program after receiving strong order demand.
why: Debt issuances by midstream infrastructure operators fund capital projects required to transport shale oil production to export terminals.

impacts.name: Vaca Muerta Oil Sur
impacts.why: Successful debt placement secures full funding for the company's capital program.
